_comment: Probe prompts for 04_validate_pipeline.py. Single shared set across V/A/D axes — phase-5 v1 simplification (the paper uses per-axis sets). Each prompt is intentionally short, neutral, and conversational so the model's response is shaped primarily by steering at layer L rather than by topic content. ~50 prompts; --probes-per-axis caps the slice per validation run.
system_prompt: You are a thoughtful conversational assistant. Respond in plain text only — do not produce audio. Keep responses to 2–4 sentences.
